bends.note: turns from nearly east-west to south-east just east of Florida Street

ends.note: stub south of Colerain Avenue ends at a lot line above the West Branch of Mill Creek
plate edge: north side of the street is cut by the plate's top edge

notes: Top street is printed HANIFIELD (no suffix seen in this strip; the brief calls it Hanfield Street). Its north side is the cut top edge of the plate, so its centre line (taken 90 px north of the south lot line, close to the 6 in. water pipe line) is less certain than the others; Florida, Kirby and Gordon run on north through notches in the plate edge. The diagonal street with the car tracks is taken as Colerain Avenue (name not printed inside this strip); centre read on the tracks, midway between the north lot fronts and the southern line. Powers Street is not named inside the strip and its south side is cut by the bottom plate edge: centre y taken as north lot line (about 7118) plus half of the printed 50 ft, so y is uncertain by 20-30 px; east of Borden it is printed 40 ft. Edgewood, Llewellyn and Borden appear to run on south of Powers (kind cross is a judgement). Edgewood, Llewellyn and Borden end at Hoffner Avenue (cemetery ground to the north). No streets between y 2000 and 5260 (Wesleyan Cemetery, creek). GEO... street joining Hanifield near x 3300 is outside the 300 px margin.
